shots.frame: Medium close-up of Stamford at the corner where a cab waits, dark hair, round clean-shaven face, black frock coat, turned back to Watson one last time, a wry smile, lips just closed, the last word on his lips; the street and the waiting cab soft behind him.
shots.motion: Static shot; Stamford speaks the line to the man behind him with the wry smile; after the line he turns his head and shoulders away from Watson toward the waiting cab over 1.5 seconds and raises an arm to hail it, the arm fully up by 5 seconds; his face stays in frame in profile.
shots.camera: at the corner on the street side of the railings, level with Stamford's eyes, a portrait lens, his head and shoulders filling the frame in three-quarter turn back toward the left edge, an iron lamp post standing at the left edge of frame and the waiting cab soft behind his right shoulder
shots.at_rest: Stamford stands stopped at the kerb of the corner with both boots planted, his shoulders squared to the street and his head turned back over his shoulder, his round clean-shaven face lit along one side, his lips just closed on the wry smile with the last word held on them, both his hands down at the sides of his black frock coat. At the left edge an iron lamp post stands on the kerb, its glass lantern cold and its ladder-rest bar plain across the stem. Behind his right shoulder a hansom waits at the corner with its horse standing square in the shafts and its cabman still on the high seat, the whole of it soft. Farther back along the pavement the iron railings run to the gateway arch, small and pale in the soot-dark wall, its two gate leaves folded back flat inside the opening. The low amber sun lies along the tops of the far roofs and the crossing below stands in blue shade. A crossing-sweeper stands at rest on his broom at the kerb, and a woman with a basket waits at the far corner.

lines.speaker: stamford
lines.text: Watson? Good Lord, man. What have you done to yourself?

lines.speaker: john_watson
lines.text: Young Stamford, from Barts. Nobody had said my name in weeks.

lines.speaker: john_watson
lines.text: I wanted cheap rooms. He gave me an odd look and named a fellow at the chemical laboratory.

lines.speaker: john_watson
lines.text: He had found rooms too dear for one purse and wanted someone to go halves.

lines.speaker: john_watson
lines.text: Afghanistan had sent me home with a ruined shoulder and eleven shillings a day.

lines.speaker: john_watson
lines.text: A man in that state does not ask who his companion is. Only the price.

lines.speaker: john_watson
lines.text: I said I was the very man. Stamford did not look at me.

lines.speaker: john_watson
lines.text: Holmes was a little too scientific, Stamford said. It approached to cold-bloodedness.

lines.speaker: john_watson
lines.text: He had seen him beating the subjects in the dissecting rooms with a stick.

lines.speaker: john_watson
lines.text: To verify, Stamford said, how far a bruise may be produced after death.

lines.speaker: john_watson
lines.text: I should have turned back. I followed him through the door.

lines.speaker: john_watson
lines.text: Cold-blooded, Stamford had said. The man sprang up shouting like a child with a new toy.

lines.speaker: john_watson
lines.text: Stamford made the introduction as if handing over a parcel.

lines.speaker: john_watson
lines.text: The man looked at my coat, my hands, my leg.

lines.speaker: sherlock_holmes
lines.text: How are you? You have been in Afghanistan, I perceive.

lines.speaker: john_watson
lines.text: I had not said one word about Afghanistan.

lines.speaker: john_watson
lines.text: He did not explain. Never mind, he said, chuckling; the question now was haemoglobin.

lines.speaker: john_watson
lines.text: An infallible test for blood stains, he said, as if that settled anything.

lines.speaker: sherlock_holmes
lines.text: We may consider the thing settled, if the rooms suit you.

lines.speaker: john_watson
lines.text: A suite in Baker Street, at noon. Before we reached the street he had forgotten us.

lines.speaker: john_watson
lines.text: How the deuce did he know I was in Afghanistan?

lines.speaker: john_watson
lines.text: Just his little peculiarity, Stamford said. A good many people had wanted to know.

lines.speaker: stamford
lines.text: He'll learn more about you than you about him.
